leadText:
Nicole (Japanese: ノリコ Noriko) is a character of the day who appeared in The Lotad Lowdown. She has two sisters, Natalie and , who, together, run the Pretty Petal flower shop located near a lake full of .

After lecturing Natalie, her younger sister, about being nice to travelers, Nicole offered and to stay over for lunch and sample the Oran Berry pie that she baked. While eating, Nicole, along with her sister Rita, invited the gang to view the flower shop's garden to see all sorts of they were growing. While touring the garden, Ash took interest in the Tamato Berry, but Nicole quickly stopped him from eating it due to its severe spiciness.

Nicole is very knowledgeable when it comes to Berries and their effects.
